title: Dimensional changes in the sinus membrane following maxillary sinus augmentation
authors: Mayer Y, Ben-Dor A, Zigdon-Giladi H, Gutmacher Z. Quintessence Int. 2018; 49(10):841-847.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Maxillary sinus floor augmentation is a safe procedure in terms of sinus membrane thickness. It seems that the membranes thickness at baseline affects the subsequent dimensional changes. The amount of bone grafting material used may not affect the thickness of the membrane” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
